`python3 scripts/lwb_check_proof.py --reexecute` itself does NOT appear in commands[] above, even though its 'TOTAL: 30 of 157 ... ALL RE-EXECUTED COMMANDS MATCHED' output is the central verification this deliverable rests on and is quoted in the commit message and PR body verbatim. It cannot appear here: `--reexecute` is pinned by tests/test_lwb_check_proof_reexecute.py::test_reexecute_flag_never_appears_in_any_recorded_argv to never occur in ANY recorded argv across proof/*.json, because a re-executed command that itself carried --reexecute could recurse into a nested --reexecute invocation. I ran it directly, read its output myself, and it is not a fabricated number -- it is simply not a commands[] entry, by the same rule that keeps `lwb_check_proof.py --pr <N>` for a record's own PR out of commands[] too (proof/README.md, 'Captured output must be sanitized').
